notes.title: Vacancy 0.0.1.5 - Quests+
notes.content:
Prepare for a meaty update:
[list]
[*] New Quest System! It only has a couple of quests in it but there it is. (Made from scratch).
[*] New custom Soundtrack by Nate BeuMaher!!! So Awesome.
[*] By popular demand, brought back the UI Time Keeper for ya, you’re welcome.
[*] Xenorama has an all new sign and is fully functional.
[/list]
Fixes:
[list]
[*] River Flow
[*] Lodging deactivation / reactivation
[*] Miysst drops would remain
[*] Pickup storage was going to the miniature hotel on the bridge (so hilarious).
[*] Research upgrade was sticking
[*] Reno pickups were being allowed in the Research station
[*] Captain Quest was pointing to the wrong place.
[*] Starting System was wrong (it is based on your Commander)
[*] Boost was breaking
[*] Reno training could be broken by a witty player, Added a action points check to assure unbreakability.
[*] In Training an extra battery could be used to break the economy training, removed it.
[*] Xenorama wouldn’t stop talking, it resets if everyone leaves the room now.
[*] Captain 3d character didn’t switch faction when choosing a new hotel.
[*] Limbo could chatter on if left early, it now terminates if u bail.
[*] Mini-Hotels had objectives and storage, removed.
[/list]
